name: dev-standards
description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace: plugins that scaffold security, compliance, and performance tooling into new or existing repos, author normative specs, and generate or audit whole products against the binding STACKSPEC/AUTHSPEC specifications.

plugins.name: luismc-agents
plugins.description: Shared custom agents (e.g. architect) for hard design judgment calls and audit-finding review, available across any project.

plugins.name: luismc-artifacts
plugins.description: Project artifacts generated from a record in the repository: a feature artifact per feature and one full-progress artifact per project, kept current by a script, hooks and five skills, to ARTIFACTSPEC.

plugins.name: luismc-audits
plugins.description: Security, performance, and compliance audit skills (security-audit, performance-audit, compliance-audit) — systematic checklists producing severity-ranked findings, no auto-fix.

plugins.name: luismc-docs
plugins.description: The documentation standard for every project, to DOCSPEC: docs layout by reader question, feature-spec template, a generated offline docs/index.html with search and a feature index, one version per release folded from change notes, checks that keep docs true to the code, a scripted move for existing repos, and a guard that keeps agent briefs and reports off the default branch.

plugins.name: luismc-delivery
plugins.description: Enforces delivery discipline from a ledger: Stop, PreToolUse, PostToolUse and SessionStart hooks plus a watcher for trains, CI, agent ETAs, concurrency caps, owner questions and attribution, to DELIVERYSPEC.

plugins.name: luismc-project-setup
plugins.description: Generates a new product monorepo conforming to the binding STACKSPEC/AUTHSPEC specifications, or audits an existing product against them. Ships the specs as references — products carry only a Stack Profile naming the version they conform to.

plugins.name: luismc-specs
plugins.description: Interviews the user and writes a normative specification to specs/ — IDed, testable requirements — before implementation starts.

plugins.name: luismc-transcript-folds
plugins.description: Folds long diffs and finished shell commands in the transcript into one line each, with a band above the prompt, two toggle chords and a session tally.
